title: GATE started by Sidney Marland in 1972, possibly as a funnel

tellings.quote: I think the gate program was started by Sydney Marland in 1972

plain: Michels suggests that GATE, an American school programme for gifted and talented children, was started in 1972 by a man named Sidney Marland, and that it may have worked as a funnel for finding unusual children for secret government purposes. Michels offers this himself as his own belief ("I think"), without giving a source, and mentions Senator Frank Church in the same discussion. If true, an ordinary school programme would have doubled as a way of screening children.
